name: PDD Holdings

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Pinduoduo logo.svg); Wikipedia logo is the Pinduoduo mark, PDD Holdings parent has no separate Wikipedia logo

description: PDD runs two marketplaces, Pinduoduo in China and Temu outside China, and sells nothing itself: its customers are the third-party merchants. Half of revenue is online marketing (merchants pay to have listings shown in search and browse results) and half is transaction services (a fee on the sales made on its platforms). The 20-F does not split revenue between Pinduoduo and Temu. Revenue grew 9.7 percent in 2025 while operating profit fell 14 percent as cost of revenues rose 23 percent, and Temu faces the end of the US duty-free import exemption and an EU Digital Services Act investigation.

hq.note: First Floor, 25 St Stephen's Green, Dublin 2 (FY2025 20-F cover). Cayman Islands holding company; China operations run through subsidiaries and a variable-interest entity.

businessLines.name: Online marketing services and others
businessLines.how: Merchants pay per impression or click to have their product listings matched into search and browse results; revenue depends on merchants' spending decisions.
businessLines.description: Merchant-paid listing promotion in search and browse results on Pinduoduo and Temu, charged on impressions or clicks.

businessLines.name: Transaction services
businessLines.how: Takes a service fee on orders merchants complete on the platforms, so it grows with active merchants and the value-added services they buy.
businessLines.description: Fees charged to merchants on transactions completed on the platforms.

brands.name: Pinduoduo
brands.segment: China marketplace (commercial operations since 2015); Duo Duo Grocery next-day pickup launched August 2020
brands.share: Not split from Temu in the 20-F

brands.name: Temu
brands.segment: Cross-border marketplace launched September 2022 (North America), Oceania March 2023, Europe April 2023, then other regions
